sara (PM): Heads-up — exec asked for a clear commit window on audit log retention + key handling for two pilot customers. Need alignment by EOD Thurs.
aj (Eng): Ack. Are we talking different retention per tier or single enterprise SLA?
mohit (Security): Prefer a tiered approach. Enterprise: 7 years for audit metadata, 1 year for full payloads unless encrypted and exportable.
claire (Legal): We need to confirm any exportability requirements in contract drafts. For regulated customers, legal often wants immutable evidence for 6+ years.
sara (PM): Proposal for scoping doc: retention matrix + KMS handshake flow + SOC2 readiness checklist. Quick sketch below:
```
Retention matrix (draft):
- Tier: Enterprise (paid)
  - Audit metadata: 7y
  - Full payloads: 1y (option to extend to 7y with customer acceptance)
  - Evidence export SLA: 72h
- Tier: Startup (standard)
  - Audit metadata: 1y
  - Full payloads: 30d
KMS: customer-managed keys allowed via KMS/HSM; handshake must support export token and rotation window.
SOC2: baseline controls implemented; documentation + evidence export runbook required for attestation.
```
tim (Infra): Technical note — keeping full payloads for 7y at scale in hot storage is expensive. We should design a cold-archive path with searchable index pointers.
aj (Eng): Agreed. Suggest two-phase: index + metadata stays in primary hot store; full payload archived to GCS cold after 90d. Retrieval path with 72h SLA.
mohit (Security): For BYOK, we must define key escrow policy. If customer rotates keys, we need a documented window where we can still decrypt for e-discovery. Ops should not hold plaintext long-term.
claire (Legal): We can accept a contract clause that customer accepts responsibility for key escrow outside of Redwood except for court-ordered requests. Need wording for service descriptions.
sara (PM): Action items:
- aj & tim: draft infra cost estimates for hot index + cold archive + retrieval SLA (due Tue)
- mohit: propose key escrow/rotation policy + SOC2 control mapping (due Wed)
- claire: draft contract language for BYOK export/escrow + evidence export SLA (due Wed)
- I'll combine into scoping doc and run stakeholder review Thurs AM
ops-bot: New doc created: https://docs.redwood/example/retention-scope-draft (permissions: product, security, legal)
aj (Eng): FYI — if we do cold archive, add a hash-based integrity proof per file for auditability.
mohit (Security): Also log KMS operations to immutable audit stream (separate from payload logs). That's a SOC2 point.
sara (PM): Good catches. We'll include both. If anyone has customer-specific asks (ACME, BankCo), drop them here now so we can include in scoping.
aj (Eng): ACME asked for 10y retention for metadata, but I flagged cost. They may pay premium; will get exact language.
claire (Legal): BankCo requires HSM-backed keys in region and e-discovery export within 48h. Flagging as potential special product tier.
sara (PM): Ok — we'll include a special tier append for BankCo in the scoping doc. Thanks all. Closing thread for now — will post revised doc Thurs AM. :thumbsup:
